verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's first-party Computer docs describe an agent that works on your real files: it reads and edits files (open-webui-docs-12, open-webui-docs-56) and runs commands under an approval mode where nothing changes on disk and no command runs until you allow it (open-webui-docs-61, open-webui-docs-37, open-webui-docs-13). Further evidence includes Python execution via Open Terminal (open-webui-docs-22), scheduled test-suite runs (open-webui-docs-14) and coding agents on worktrees (open-webui-docs-36), and a community comment cites code execution as a key feature (open-webui-comm-1). missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of local command execution and file editing, detailed docs on the shell or terminal exec surface itself (most evidence is use-case pages for the separate Computer component).
